dish.title: Japanese Vegetable Omurice with Mushroom Ketchup Rice
dish.description: Short-grain rice stir-fried with onion, carrot, cremini mushrooms, peas, ketchup, and soy sauce, shaped into ovals and draped with a soft, barely set two-egg omelet, finished with a zigzag of ketchup.

recipe_version.title: Japanese Vegetable Omurice with Mushroom Ketchup Rice
recipe_version.description: Short-grain rice stir-fried with onion, carrot, cremini mushrooms, peas, ketchup, and soy sauce, shaped into ovals and draped with a soft, barely set two-egg omelet, finished with a zigzag of ketchup.

ingredients.name: ketchup
ingredients.display_name: ketchup whose label lists tomato concentrate, vinegar, sugar, salt, and spices
ingredients.note: 1/3 cup rice, the rest on top

steps.title: Rinse the rice
steps.body: Rinse the rice in a strainer until the rinse runs clear.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice with 1 3/4 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan and bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes. Cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes, then leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: While the rice cooks (overlap stated): finely chop the onion, dice the carrot and mushrooms, and beat the eggs in pairs with a pinch of salt each in 4 small cups.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp oil in the 12-inch skillet over medium-high, about 1 minute. Cook the onion and carrot, stirring, about 4 minutes, add the mushrooms and cook until browned, about 4 minutes, then add the peas, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Stir-fry the rice
steps.body: Add the rice, 1/3 cup ketchup, the soy sauce, and the remaining salt and stir-fry until the rice is evenly red and the ketchup smells toasted, about 4 minutes. Press each quarter into an oval on 4 plates.

steps.title: Make the omelets
steps.body: Heat 1 tsp oil in the 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium. Pour in one pair of eggs, stir with a fork for 30 seconds, then let it set until the bottom is firm and the top still glossy, about 1 1/2 minutes. Slide it over a rice oval. Repeat for each omelet.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Zigzag the remaining ketchup over each omelet.

coverage_contribution: No omurice or omelet-over-rice dinner is in the catalog; the egg mains are shakshuka, a Spanish tortilla, egg foo young, and tomato-egg stir-fry. A vegetarian Japanese home-cooking classic that is HH001-eligible.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with chinese-egg-foo-young: a soft omelet draped over seasoned ketchup rice, not deep-golden egg patties with gravy. Compared with chinese-tomato-egg-stir-fry: rice shaped under a whole omelet, not scrambled eggs with tomato over rice. Compared with kimchi-fried-rice: a mild ketchup-mushroom rice under egg, not a spicy kimchi rice. Compared with japanese-hambagu: a vegetarian rice-and-omelet plate, not a beef patty.
not_duplicate_of: Not a fried-rice dish: the rice is a base for the omelet and the omelet is the hero.
